artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated figure from mid-torso and above, with a calm expression. The person has distinct facial features, shoulder-length hair, and wears a robe with long sleeves. A halo surrounds their head. Beside them is a winged animal with a lion and eagle-like face. The person holds a scroll on their lap. The background is textured, and the image is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground, facing left. They have distinct facial features and a halo above their head. The person wears a cloak with patterns and holds a scroll. Next to them is an animal-like creature with wings.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene depicting an execution. The scene features a figure tied to a post with arrows penetrating their body. Two figures are standing nearby with bows and crossbows. In the background, more figures are gathered, in a rocky landscape with a town or castle in the distance. The drawing conveys a narrative scene typical of stories from the medieval period, focusing on punishment or martyrdom. The intricate line work and detailed figures suggest a historical or allegory-rich context.

artworks.title: The Knight and the Lady
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.9 x 11.3 cm (5 1/2 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing side by side. On the left, a woman with curly hair, a floral wreath, and a staff with a banner is softy looking to her side. On the right, a man with long wavy hair, exotic features, and wearing armor is standing with one hand on his hip, holding a helmet in his other hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Letter "K"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three wild men armed with spears and a shield. The artwork features three figures with exaggerated features, covered in curly hair, brandishing large spears and a shield, while a small animal is at their feet. The wild men have thick, swirling, vine-like hair enveloping their entire bodies, blending into their bushy beards and eyebrows. One figure holds a long flag atop a spear, and another appears to leap at an angle. The figures' expressions are intense, and their stance is dynamic, giving a sense of movement and energy.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a standing figure in a frontal position. The person has detailed facial features, depicted as an older male with short, curly hair. They are wearing a long flowing robe and holding a large key and an open book. A halo with the words "S. Petrus" and decorative ribbons with Latin text surround the figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.6 x 21.3 cm (10 1/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an artwork portraying a king seated on a throne, adorned with a crown and dressed in elaborate robes. The king is serious, with wavy hair and a crowd in front of him. Various figures, including a woman with a child, are depicted in medieval or early Renaissance attire. The background features architectural elements and a checkered floor pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate): 18.1 x 9.5 cm (7 1/8 x 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, facing right, with a short beard and mustache, gazing upwards. He wears layered robes, holds a book against a large cross, and has a halo above his head. He is barefoot on a textured surface, against a plain background.

artworks.title: Saint Judas Thaddaeus
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is facing slightly to the right, holding a saw in his right hand and a book in his left hand against his chest. The man has a beard, curly hair, and a thoughtful expression. He wears flowing robes and there is a halo above his head. The background is plain with simple flooring pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a standing man holding a staff with a cross at the top in his left hand, and an open book in his right hand. The man has short, curly hair and a halo around his head. He is dressed in long robes, with one layer of fabric draped over his shoulder and body. The setting features a rectangular framing around the figure, a tiled floor pattern below his feet, and a plain background with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.artist: Master FVB and Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight slaying a dragon. The drawing depicts a scene where a knight in full armor is mounted on a rearing horse, slaying a dragon with a sword. The dragon lies on its back with its jaws open. The knight's armor and the dragon's scales are detailed. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, and a castle on a cliff. A figure is seen standing in the distance. The composition has lines and forms that create movement and tension.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a crucifixion scene. In the center, a man is crucified on a large ornate cross, with arms outstretched and head tilted downward. He wears a crown of thorns, a loincloth, and has long hair and a beard. To the left, a woman stands with hands clasped, wearing a long garment and a halo. On the right, another male figure stands with a halo, draped in robes. Beneath the cross is a small skull among stones. The background features hills, trees, and distant structures under a softly shaded sky.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Lion and Unicorn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms featuring a unicorn. The illustration includes a shield with a rampant lion, a helmet above the shield, and a unicorn emerging from the helmet. Surrounding the coat of arms are intricate floral and leafy scrolls. The background includes handwritten script in old-style cursive. The paper appears aged with wear at the edges.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing upright. He is holding a book in his left hand and a staff in his right. He has a long beard, deep-set eyes, and wears a hat that covers his head and long, wavy hair. He is dressed in a robe with a cross emblem on the shoulder and leather shoes. A pig is positioned by his left side. The background is plain, with a textured pattern on the floor, framed by a border.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.artist: Master with the Banderoles after Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 x 20.7 cm (5 1/2 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting with objects and an architectural structure. The drawing depicts a scene where individuals are engaged in actions with stone-like objects. Some figures are throwing or lifting stones, while others are reacting to the situation. The figures are dressed in historical or medieval attire, and a grand castle with tall towers and conical roofs occupies the background. The composition emphasizes movement and tension, highlighted by flowing garments and gestures. The line work and cross-hatching techniques contribute to the texture and depth of the drawing.

artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, with mountains reaching towards it. In the center-left, there is a town with towers and spires near the shore. The artwork uses fine, intricate etching-style brushstrokes to depict clouds, mountains, and the sea. The color scheme is monochrome, with black and white tones. Several figures are near us, with three seated in conversation and a lone traveler with a walking stick observing. In the distance, more figures are seen on a path or heading towards the town. The sky has expressive clouds, and vessels are visible in the calm waters near the town.

artworks.title: The Creation of Eve
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set at the base of a large tree with other trees visible in the background. The composition captures intricate foliage and bark textures, showcasing detailed linework typical of wood engravings. Central in the foreground is an elaborately robed figure that appears to be an elderly man with a long beard and a cap characterized by its elaborate design. The figure is engaged in an interaction with a smaller, nude figure emerging from the side of the tree. At the base of the image, a reclining figure is depicted with closed eyes. To the right, in the backdrop, an animal resembling a deer can be subtly discerned. The artist's monogram and year are engraved at the top left. The piece emphasizes detailed engraving techniques, typical of the period’s woodcut illustrations, with a keen focus on texture and storytelling.

artworks.title: God Forbids to Eat from the Tree
artworks.description: This print shows three people with pale skin. On the left are a man and a woman, both depicted fully nude. They stand closely together on the left side of the image, facing the right where the third person stands. The woman has long, wavy hair that falls past her shoulders, and the man has curly, short hair. The third person, situated on the right, is an older man, cloaked in a long, flowing robe. He has long hair and a beard, and his clothing is detailed, featuring elaborate folds and patterns. He is positioned with one arm raised upward, pointing with his index finger. The background consists of large tree trunks with thick foliage and round fruit overhead, along with small stones on the ground beneath the bare feet of the people.

artworks.title: The Temptation by the Snake
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures, a man and a woman, standing side by side. The man is on the right holding a fruit and the woman is on the left holding a fruit and presenting it to the man. The man has curly hair and the woman has long flowing hair. They are surrounded by a lush environment with a tree on the right and a serpent descending from its thick trunk towards the figures. In the background, there is more foliage and a lion's head subtly integrated at the base of the tree.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve Hide Themselves
artworks.description: The image shows two predominantly nude figures alongside a third figure cloaked in robes. The nudity is partially obscured by strategic positioning and gestures. The two nude figures, a male and female, stand closely together, slightly turned toward the cloaked figure, with their arms directed toward their bodies. Both have curly hair, with the male's hair being more prominent. The third person, an older male, has long wavy hair and a beard, and he is depicted gesturing towards the other two with one hand. He wears a flowing robe that drapes over his figure. The background is composed of large, elaborately detailed tree trunks with abundant foliage. Pebbles and rocks are scattered across the foreground.

artworks.title: Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: The image shows three figures outdoors. On the left, a male figure with curly hair is covering his lower body. Next to him, a woman with long hair is standing with her hands clasped near her chest. On the right, an angelic figure with large wings, curly hair, and a serious expression is holding a sword aloft with one hand while gesturing with the other. The background includes large trees with textured bark and dense foliage.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve at Work
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor setting. On the left, a person stands slightly bent while holding a wooden object. They have curly hair and wear a sleeveless garment. To the right, another person is seated, holding a child. The seated person has long hair and wears a similar garment. The child is wrapped in their embrace. The background features trees and plants. The image is detailed and shaded. In the top right corner, there is a rectangular space with lines and a symbol.

artworks.title: David Casting Off His Robes at the News of the Death of His Son
artworks.description: The image shows three men, one seated and two standing. The seated man has a beard, expressive eyebrows, and a turban-like headpiece. He wears a robe and holds a staff. The man closest to him has a balding head, a beard, a mustache, and wears a formal garment. The third man wears a hat. Their attire is detailed with elaborate patterns and gathered sleeves. The background includes textured elements and architectural columns on the right side.

artworks.title: Susanna Surprised by the Two Elders
artworks.artist: anonymous Germany 16th Century after Heinrich Aldegrever
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure beside a fountain in a medieval town setting. The image shows a seated nude figure next to a fountain with a curved water spout running into a large pitcher. The background features the architecture of a medieval town, including buildings with visible bricks, arches, and a clock on a structure on the left-hand side. A tree is positioned to the right of the fountain, and in the distance, two figures can be seen beyond a small pool, one of whom appears to be gesturing or holding an object. The style features intricate line work and textures typical of early Renaissance etchings.
